description: Implementation of the Code 3 of 9 barcode standard within the PDFsharp library, including rendering, validation, and line pattern definitions.

classes.name: Code3of9Standard
classes.description: Represents the Code 3 of 9 barcode standard with rendering and validation functionalities.

methods.name: ThickThinLines
methods.description: Returns an array representing the pattern of thick and thin lines for a given character.

methods.name: CalcThinBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of thin bars based on the size and text length.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Validates that the input string can be encoded in the Code 3 of 9 barcode standard.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the barcode onto a graphics context.

methods.name: RenderNextChar
methods.description: Renders the next character in the barcode text.

methods.name: RenderChar
methods.description: Renders a single character pattern in the barcode.

methods.name: RenderStart
methods.description: Renders the start pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: RenderStop
methods.description: Renders the stop pattern of the barcode.
